rules.title: Boston ban on rental assistance (source-of-income) discrimination in housing
rules.requirement: In Boston, landlords may not discriminate against applicants or tenants based on rental assistance, such as refusing Section 8, social security disability, or veterans vouchers. The Boston Fair Housing Commission enforces this.
rules.coverage_conditions: Renting, buying, selling, or financing any housing in the City of Boston; protected classes include rental assistance, along with race, color, religion, disability, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, family status, and military status.
rules.citation: Boston fair housing law enforced by the Boston Fair Housing Commission (official citation not stated in document)
rules.quoted_span: The landlord tells you they don't accept rental assistance.
rules.conflict_note: The page does not give the ordinance citation or effective date. The page states that the commission enforces local, state, and federal fair housing laws. It does not specify whether the source-of-income protection derives from the city ordinance or from state law (M.G.L. c. 151B).
